summary: Shows the family tree screen for one case, with a card for each recorded family member.
purpose: Lets the user see who is recorded as part of the family connected to the land holding.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It is a separate page so the family view can be opened from the case navigation.
how: Loads the case through the shared case wrapper, reads the list of family members, and draws a card for each one. If the list is empty, it shows an empty message instead. Labels come from the chosen language.
inputs: Case details supplied by the shared case wrapper, the chosen language, and the case id from the web address.
outputs: A page with a title, the case navigation bar, and member cards or an empty message.
risks: The rendering line is cut off in the packet, so the empty-state branch and the card contents cannot be fully confirmed from these notes.
